title: Story bed: curious
description: A harp ostinato, soft bowed-vibes sustains and the motif augmented on soft vibes; kalimba, pizzicato and a muted frame drum from bar 8; marimba from bar 16.
usage: The motif version: for intros, outros and gaps between lines. Under speech prefer the -underscore version. Loops seamlessly. -26 LUFS-S with a voice pocket at 1.25-2 kHz for the narration; duck it with scripts/audio/duck.py (the band-split duck, its default). All four story beds share 75 BPM, so they can be switched on a bar line (every 3.2 s).
selfReview: F lydian: a harp ostinato, high bowed-vibes sustains and the motif augmented on soft vibes; kalimba and pizzicato from bar 8, marimba from 16. Critic round 1 (2026-11-24): the bowed vibes came down 6 dB (they were a constant line at 1 kHz under the voice), the marimba, harp and pad are narrower (correlation 0.52, windowed minimum +0.17, mono loss 1.4 dB; it was 0.37, -0.12 and 1.75 dB, with an anti-correlated marimba; boxiness 1.9 dB, was 3.7), the celesta is gone (soft vibes carry the motif) and the bus takes 2 dB out of 700 Hz. Under Zoo with the band-split duck the 1-4 kHz median SNR is 14-15 dB (6 dB before, with 40 % of speech frames under 3 dB; now 17-18 %) and the narrowest band has 10 dB of margin (3.8 before). Still open: it loses only 2.6-2.8 LU on the phone model against Zoo's 5.4, so on a phone it sits about 2.5 dB more forward against him than on headphones. The -underscore version mutes the motif and lead lines; use it under speech.
